definitions.gloss: as expected; as hoped; according to expectations
definitions.explanation: Describes a result or outcome that matches what was anticipated or hoped for.

examples.japanese: {期待通|きたいどお}りの{結果|けっか}だった。
{新商品|しんしょうひん}は{期待通|きたいどお}りによく{売|う}れた。
examples.english: The new product sold well, just as expected.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{期待通|きたいどお}りの{活躍|かつやく}を{見|み}せてくれた。
examples.english: He performed just as well as we had hoped.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as an adverb or as a no-adjective modifying nouns. Often appears in sentences evaluating outcomes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期待通|きたいどお}りの{結果|けっか} (the expected result)
- {期待通|きたいどお}りの{成果|せいか} (the expected achievement)
- {期待通|きたいどお}りに{進|すす}む (to proceed as expected)

RELATED PATTERNS:
Other 〜{通|どお}り patterns: {予想通|よそうどお}り (as predicted), {計画通|けいかくどお}り (as planned), {思|おも}った{通|とお}り (as one thought).
